records_captured: Round-by-round pairings and winners of the same tournaments (Swiss phase 1, top cut phases 2+)

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Tournament phase: 1 is Swiss, later phases are the top cut

fields.name: player2_handle
fields.description: Second player's handle; empty for a bye

fields.name: winner_handle
fields.description: The winner's handle, "0" for a tie, "-1" for no result

fields.name: fetched_at_utc
fields.description: When this tournament's rows were last fetched from the API. Unlike extracted_at_utc it survives a reuse, so a copy fetched mid-event is fetched again rather than kept (pipelines/extract/limitless_play.py, _is_final).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The tournament's standings (or pairings) page on play.limitlesstcg.com

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Unique row id within the source

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: The API reports a tie as 0 and no result as -1 rather than a handle
